summary: 'REV2 CURRENT STATE, snapshot ed18792c65 (fleet base 8593b93c4d).


  MEASURED: raw direct `.RepresentableBy` result headers remain 3 to 3, while strict
  binder-clean, logically deduplicated unconditional producer facts remain 2 to 2.
  `divFunctorAffZeroRepresentableBy` is excluded from the strict count because its
  result omits `pi` but its declaration retains externally supplied `{pi}` and `[IsAffineHom
  pi]` and uses that map in the universal section. The genus Sigma package is a fourth
  textual spelling, but its `.2` is the direct genus theorem, so that pair is one
  construction. Representability-binder consumer declarations remain 143 to 143 (lexical
  `(rep :)` sites 128 to 128). The only broad syntactic increase, 19 to 20, is a conditional
  Sigma result swept by system baseline aa33dc913a; no attributable fleet lane is
  net consumers.


  CORRECTED FRONTIER: divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy now supplies the widened
  divisor representation at genus, so the former claim that no sorry-free rep witness
  exists is superseded. Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAffChallenge removes that binder but still
  assumes hf : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf for every restricted chart and full PointwiseCoverage.
  The admissible-parameter chart-locus endpoint is larger than genus in positive genus
  and its own source explicitly does not supply hf or the pointwise-to-neighborhood
  morphism. Thus parameter decoupling is necessary but not the final Pic0 gate.


  LIVE GATES: (1) unconditional widened representation at admissibleCoverageParameter;
  (2) restricted-chart open immersion; (3) neighborhood/pointwise coverage on the
  same charts; then consume all three in the Pic0 theorem. Do not credit parameter
  plumbing or the conditional Sigma result as a producer. Final counts, axioms, import
  closure, and root build remain pending until the prover fleet ends.


  STRATEGY PIVOT (fleet 2, fd0723ae83): the raw admissible Abel map cannot itself
  be the open chart because its linear-system fibres are positive-dimensional. The
  active terminal route is now to finish the unconditional divFunctorAff representer
  at admissibleCoverageParameter, quotient its representing scheme by equality of
  the induced Pic0 class (linear equivalence), prove the quotient map locally surjective,
  and represent that quotient sheaf by a scheme Q. The hf/hcov list above remains
  an honest inventory for the conditional raw-chart theorem, but it is no longer the
  current terminal strategy.'

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

data.command:
/bin/bash -lc "while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
  if [ "'! -e "$p" ]; then
    printf '"'MISSING\\t%s\\n' \""'$p"
    continue
  fi
  disk=$("$HORIZON_GIT" hash-object "$p")
  head=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse "HEAD:$p")
  if [ "$disk" != "$head" ]; then
    printf '"'MODIFIED\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \""'$p" "$head" "$disk"
  fi

/-- Equality of the two intrinsic epsilon windows with the mapped universal windows identifies
the induced pair-chart morphism with any framed pair-chart morphism. -/
theorem pairChartMap_eq_of_eps_eq_universal
    (i0 : (glueData k g r1).J) (j0 : (glueData k g r2).J)
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
    (alpha : ChartRing i0 j0 →ₐ[k] T)
    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C T g)
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (w : PairChartRing k g r1 g r2 i j →ₐ[k] T)
    (hw : G.IsPairChartFramed hpi g b1 b2 i j w)
    (heps1 : (G.eps hpi g).1 =
      (Module.Grassmannian.map alpha
        (divUniversalFstWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)).toSubmodule)
    (heps2 : (G.eps hpi g).2 =
      (Module.Grassmannian.map alpha
        (divUniversalSndWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)).toSubmodule) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
          (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
          (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
          g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)).toRingHom)) ≫
        pairChartMap k g r1 g r2 i0 j0 =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w.toRingHom) ≫ pairChartMap k g r1 g r2 i j := by
  have hcoord1 :
      congrAmbient b1.equivFun
          (Module.Grassmannian.map alpha
            (divUniversalFstWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)) =
        Module.Grassmannian.map
          (alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
            (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0))
          (pairTautFst k g r1 r2 i0 j0) :=
    map_divUniversalFstWindow_eq_map_pairTautFst
      (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) i0 j0 alpha
  have hcoord2 :
      congrAmbient b2.equivFun
          (Module.Grassmannian.map alpha
            (divUniversalSndWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)) =
        Module.Grassmannian.map
          (alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
            (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0))
          (pairTautSnd k g r1 r2 i0 j0) :=
    map_divUniversalSndWindow_eq_map_pairTautSnd
      (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) i0 j0 alpha
  have hmap1 :
      Module.Grassmannian.map
          (alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
            (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0))
          (pairTautFst k g r1 r2 i0 j0) =
        Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r1 r2 i j) := by
    apply Module.Grassmannian.ext
    rw [hw.1, heps1, ← congrAmbient_toSubmodule]
    exact congrArg Module.Grassmannian.toSubmodule hcoord1.symm
  have hmap2 :
      Module.Grassmannian.map
          (alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
            (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0))
          (pairTautSnd k g r1 r2 i0 j0) =
        Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r1 r2 i j) := by
    apply Module.Grassmannian.ext
    rw [hw.2, heps2, ← congrAmbient_toSubmodule]
    exact congrArg Module.Grassmannian.toSubmodule hcoord2.symm
  have hpair := specMap_pairChartMap_eq_of_map_pairTaut_eq
    k g r1 r2 i0 i j0 j
      (alpha.comp (divCarveChartMk k
        (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
        g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)) w hmap1 hmap2
  exact hpair

/-- The explicit-algebra-map comparison specializes to the canonical divisor-chart triangle. -/
theorem divCarveChart_classifies_of_eps_eq_universal
    (i0 : (glueData k g r1).J) (j0 : (glueData k g r2).J)
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
    [Algebra (ChartRing i0 j0) T] [IsScalarTower k (ChartRing i0 j0) T]
    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C T g)
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (w : PairChartRing k g r1 g r2 i j →ₐ[k] T)
    (hw : G.IsPairChartFramed hpi g b1 b2 i j w)
    (heps1 : (G.eps hpi g).1 =
      (Module.Grassmannian.map
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (ChartRing i0 j0) T)
        (divUniversalFstWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)).toSubmodule)
    (heps2 : (G.eps hpi g).2 =
      (Module.Grassmannian.map
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (ChartRing i0 j0) T)
        (divUniversalSndWindow C pi hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2c i0 j0)).toSubmodule) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (ChartRing i0 j0) T)) ≫
        ChartMap i0 j0 ≫
          divSchemeι k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
            (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2c =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w.toRingHom) ≫ pairChartMap k g r1 g r2 i j := by
  have hpair := pairChartMap_eq_of_eps_eq_universal
    (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
    (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) i0 j0
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (ChartRing i0 j0) T) G i j w hw heps1 heps2
  rw [divCarveChartToDivScheme_divSchemeι
      (k := k)
      (A := windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
      (B := windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
      (g := g) (r₁ := r1) (r₂ := r2) (b₁ := b1) (b₂ := b2c) i0 j0,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  exact hpair
